summary: Himax filed a routine Form -K furnished under Rule 13a-16, is the foreign private issuer that issued quarterly results and posted the release. Q3 2026 revenue USD 246.8m, +8.5% QoQ, gross margin 34.2%, after-tax profit USD 18.6m (10.7 cents/diluted ADS), slightly above guidance; Q4 revenue guided down 22-26% QoQ due to abrupt customer order corrections in automotive TDDI/DDIC, with profit 4.5-6.5 cents/ADS. No transaction, so no deal terms apply; watch automotive order volatility and CPO ramp.
